title: Prepare your account, PC, and budget

title: Check the model deployment you will use
summary: Confirm the supplied model, version, and cost conditions; save its actual deployment name.

title: Get your first answer from code
summary: Send one question through the Responses API and read the answer and response ID.

title: Create an agent with a clear role
summary: Give a Prompt Agent rules, then compare the same conversation with a new one.

title: Answer from company documents
summary: Use File search to retrieve policies and inspect actual supporting evidence.

title: Check stock and prepare a purchase draft
summary: Use functions to check inventory and amounts; stop at a draft awaiting human approval.

title: Compare answers and read evaluations

title: Reject missing facts and false approval
summary: Use three boundary questions to distinguish verbal refusal from actual function rejection.

title: Follow an answer's execution path

title: Check the completed purchasing assistant
summary: Review L06's saved result against five items. Finish without publishing to Teams.

title: Finish the lab and check remaining costs
summary: Record resource state, retention ownership, and the next cost-check time.

title: AI Search, Foundry IQ, and permission-aware retrieval
summary: Move beyond a few files to enterprise knowledge from multiple sources.

title: Hosted agents and developer tools
summary: Move your code and framework into a managed runtime.

title: Agent Framework orchestrations
summary: Compare sequential, concurrent, group-chat, and handoff execution flows and results using the same purchasing question.

title: Memory: remembering and forgetting
summary: Separate conversation state from long-term memory and preserve user boundaries.

title: Routines, long-running agents, and Autopilot
summary: Distinguish scheduling, recovery, and the identity behind an execution.

title: Enterprise security, Control Plane, and gateways
summary: Design control boundaries across tenants, projects, tools, and data.

title: CI/CD, costs, and model lifecycle
summary: Read CI results and design agent releases, rollback, and model-retirement responses. Live deployment needs separate approval.

title: Troubleshooting by symptom

title: Instructor plan and completion checklist
summary: Plan a 90-minute, one-day, or two-day workshop and record costs and outcomes.

title: Glossary and decision guide
summary: Clarify confusing names with short definitions and selection criteria.

title: Feature coverage
summary: See how official capability groups map to the labs.

title: Sources, currency, and execution boundaries
summary: Check official sources and distinguish execution from quality claims.
